language.title: Language
language.lead: Language of the interface on this device.

notifications.title: Notifications on this device
notifications.lead: Get a notification for every request. On iPhone, first add Artemis to your Home Screen (Share → Add to Home Screen).
notifications.notConfigured: Push notifications are not configured on this server (VAPID keys). Emails remain active.
notifications.unsupported: This browser does not support push notifications.
notifications.denied: Notifications are blocked in the browser settings.

slack.lead: Every pending request is posted to a Slack channel, with a button that opens passkey approval. Create an “Incoming Webhook” in Slack and paste its URL.

delivery.title: Card handover to agents
delivery.confirmDirect: Direct handover: the card number will pass through Artemis once on its way to the agent. This puts you in PCI DSS scope and, with Revolut, requires written approval. Continue?
delivery.linkText: The agent receives a single-use link valid for 10 minutes; the card is displayed by the issuing bank (Stripe Issuing). The number never passes through Artemis.
delivery.directText: The number is relayed to the agent only once, without being stored. Required for Revolut. You enter PCI DSS scope.

emergency.title: Emergency
emergency.lead: “Freeze all” suspends every agent and cancels active cards and pending requests. Use it if an agent behaves abnormally or if a token has leaked.
emergency.confirmFreeze: Freeze the entire organization? All agents will be frozen and active cards cancelled.
emergency.afterUnfreeze: After unfreezing, reactivate each agent from its page.

passkeys.title: Passkeys
passkeys.lead: A passkey is required to approve a spend. Add one on every device you use.
passkeys.none: No passkey: you can't approve spending yet.
